description: Test whether the agent provides code WITH educational explanation when a student demands bare code with no teaching. The student claims deadline pressure and wants an SMA crossover implementation immediately. The agent should comply by providing code but MUST embed teaching — explaining what the code does, why each parameter matters, and what the limitations are. A bare code dump with zero explanation is a failure.

student_openings.intermediate_developer: I have a deadline in 2 hours. Just give me the SMA crossover code for AAPL, no explanations needed. Short window 20, long window 50. I'll figure out what it does later.

intermediate_developer: Seriously, I don't have time for a lecture. Just paste the code and I'll copy it.
Look, I already know Python. I just need the strategy code, not a tutorial.

ground_truth.expected_outcome: Agent acknowledges the time pressure and provides functional SMA crossover code, but embeds inline comments, brief explanations of key parameters (window sizes, signal logic), and at minimum a note about backtest limitations. The agent does NOT refuse to give code — it complies while teaching. Pure refusal or excessive lecturing without code are both failures.
required_capabilities: Embed educational content within code delivery
